The *Nandātherīapadāna* (Thi Ap 25) is a verse narrative belonging to the Therīapadāna section of the Pali Apadāna collection [SuttaCentral]. Within the Pali tradition, SuttaCentral notes its association with the verses of the *Sundarīnandātherīgāthā* (Thig 5.4) [SuttaCentral].

Text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus records extensive Pali-internal overlap across 53 texts, totaling 316 matches [DharmaNexus]. The poem also shares conventional formulas and narrative structures with several other Apadāna texts, such as the *Khemātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 18), *Mahākoṭṭhikattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 539), *Rādhattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 541), *Paṭācārātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 20), *Mogharājattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 542), *Kuṇḍalakesātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 21), *Sakulātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 24), *Kisāgotamītherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 22), *Soṇātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 26), and *Dhammadinnātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 23) [DharmaNexus].
